title: A finite quantum-gravity construction with exact local conservation
description:
Read the full paper (PDF)

A single finite Fold lattice carries complete binary quantum support, a symmetric rank-two gravitational source, two physical polarizations and exact local conservation.

Maria Smith derives the full construction at every positive depth: support 2^d, positive distance floor 2^-d, finite rational loop sum 1−2^-d and horizon record 2^d/4. All thirteen defining successor conditions hold at every depth.

The paper presents the unique admissible self-source fixed point 1/4 and exact error/correction contraction factors below 1/4; four complete forty-eight-to-forty-eight divergence ledgers; conservation for every admitted positive rational cycle; complete causal balls and exact successor boundaries; and bijective composition of coprime Fold components with least-common-multiple recurrence and source-independent target trajectories.

Every derivation is developed in the paper, including the full nineteen-field model, five exhaustive construction grammars and complete composite unit maps. Original external comparison records are retained. The accompanying archive provides pinned V3 sources, native Lean 4 proof bodies, applicable build and zero-axiom audit results, complete source-output comparisons and portable exact-arithmetic reproduction.
